description: Phase 5: Therapist Bridge PDF + Crisis Detection with consented escalation - disclaimer_acceptances table, generate-therapist-brief edge function, client-side PDF generation via pdf-lib, entry redaction UI, crisis detection edge function, crisis_events table, 3-step consent flow, in-app crisis card with locale-appropriate resources, and trusted contact notification.
steps: Create migration supabase/migrations/20260601000005_phase5_clinical.sql with: CREATE TABLE disclaimer_acceptances (id uuid PK, user_id uuid references auth.users on delete cascade, feature_key text not null, disclaimer_version text not null, accepted_at timestamptz default now(), UNIQUE(user_id, feature_key, disclaimer_version)), RLS: select where user_id=auth.uid(), insert with check user_id=auth.uid(). ALTER profiles ADD COLUMN crisis_detection_enabled boolean not null default false, ADD COLUMN crisis_detection_locale_approved boolean not null default false, ADD COLUMN trusted_contact jsonb. ALTER journal_analysis ADD COLUMN crisis_signal numeric, ADD COLUMN crisis_signal_threshold_breached boolean default false. CREATE TABLE crisis_events (id uuid PK, user_id uuid references auth.users on delete cascade, journal_id uuid references journals(id) on delete cascade, signal_score numeric not null, threshold numeric not null, surfaced_at timestamptz default now(), user_action text check (in called_988/called_samaritans/contacted_trusted/dismissed/none), user_action_at timestamptz, trusted_notified boolean not null default false), RLS: select/update where user_id=auth.uid(), insert for service_role.

Create supabase/functions/generate-therapist-brief/index.ts: authenticates user, reads last 30 days of journal_analysis (admin client). If <3 entries return 422 {code: 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA'}. If E2EE enabled return 403 {code: 'E2EE_REQUIRES_CLIENT'}. 30-second timeout enforced. Calls Gemini to produce: up to 5 themes, up to 3 distortions, mood arc (intensity_score + clarity_score series), 3-5 representative entries (highest deviation from running averages), 500-word summary. Returns JSON (not PDF - PDF generated client-side).
Add pdf-lib to package.json dependencies (npm install pdf-lib).

Create src/lib/therapist-brief.ts: generateTherapistBriefPDF(briefData, redactedEntryIds) function using pdf-lib. Renders: header with NexoMind branding, Phase-5 disclaimer block, themes section, distortions section, mood arc as SVG sparkline (embedded as image), representative entries (with redacted ones excluded), summary, footer 'Generated by NexoMind on YYYY-MM-DD'. Returns Uint8Array PDF.

Create src/pages/app/TherapistBridge.tsx: (1) Check disclaimer_acceptances for 'therapist_bridge' - if not accepted, show Phase-5 disclaimer modal with locale-appropriate resources (988 for en-US, Samaritans for en-GB) requiring acknowledgment. (2) Once accepted, show generate button. (3) On generate: call generate-therapist-brief, show preview with per-entry redaction checkboxes. (4) Confirm button generates PDF client-side and triggers download. (5) Reminder scheduling: modal with time picker (1h to 7d) for local notification. Gate behind premium tier and useFeatureFlag('therapist_bridge').

Create supabase/functions/detect-crisis/index.ts: invoked from analyze-journal when profiles.crisis_detection_enabled=true AND disclaimer_acceptances exists for crisis_detection. Computes crisis_signal as weighted sum: text-pattern score (regex patterns on key_thoughts + summary for hopelessness/self-harm indicators) + voice biomarker delta (large negative pace deviation + high hesitation ratio). 9-second timeout. Loads threshold from feature_flags config. On breach: insert crisis_events row, set journal_analysis.crisis_signal_threshold_breached=true. Never auto-contacts emergency services.

Update supabase/functions/analyze-journal/index.ts: after storing analysis, if crisis_detection_enabled=true for the user and disclaimer accepted, fire-and-forget invoke detect-crisis with the analysis data.

Create src/components/app/CrisisDetectionCard.tsx for Settings: 3-step consent flow (disclaimer ack -> signal explanation -> opt-in confirm). Shows trusted contact form when enabled. Locale gate: disabled with copy when crisis_detection_locale_approved=false. Gate behind useFeatureFlag('crisis_detection') and premium tier.

Create src/components/app/CrisisCard.tsx: overlay component that subscribes to crisis_events via Supabase realtime. On new event with threshold_breached: render card with 988/Samaritans/locale links + trusted contact action button. User can dismiss (logs as false-positive) or take action. Trusted contact notification sends <=280 chars, no plaintext.

Create src/components/app/DisclaimerModal.tsx: reusable modal for Phase 5 disclaimers. Shows feature-specific copy, locale-appropriate resources, requires checkbox acknowledgment, persists to disclaimer_acceptances on confirm.
Add TherapistBridge route to app router. Add navigation link.
Add i18n keys for all Phase 5 strings (disclaimer text, crisis resources by locale, therapist bridge labels, redaction UI, reminder scheduling).
acceptance_criteria: Therapist Bridge requires disclaimer acceptance before use
Brief generation fails gracefully with <3 entries (422 INSUFFICIENT_DATA)
PDF includes disclaimer footer and mood arc visualization
Entry redaction checkboxes exclude entries from PDF
Crisis Detection requires 3-step consent before activation
Trusted contact notification is <=280 chars with no plaintext
Locale-unapproved users see crisis detection as unavailable
Both features gated behind premium tier and feature flags
verification: Run npm run build and confirm zero errors
Run npm run test and confirm tests pass
findings: pdf-lib added (109 packages, pure JS). TherapistBridge chunk is ~441KB due to pdf-lib bundling but code-split via lazy loading. Build warns about chunk size but succeeds. All 14 tests pass. Crisis detection patterns use weighted regex scoring with a default threshold of 0.6. Edge functions follow existing patterns (corsHeaders, Bearer auth, admin client).
